_comment: Models used via OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/models). "model" is an OpenRouter model slug — edit it to try a different model, no code changes needed. "default" applies to every text-generation tab; add a "scripts"/"thumbnails"/"ideas" key with any of the same fields to override it for just that tab. "thumbnailImage" is the separate image-generation model that renders the actual thumbnail from the prompt the "thumbnails" model writes — must be an image-capable model (e.g. a Nano Banana or GPT Image slug).
